entries.zh: 窥视、窥探（暗中观看）；西语词头 Escuchar 本义为听，此处或取偷听、窃听之相通义
entries.en: to peep, pry, spy; Spanish headword escuchar (to listen), here likely in the sense of to eavesdrop
entries.notes: H 栏『窺』（视）与西语 escuchar（听）感官不合，据汉字为主取『暗中』相通义；R 栏空缺

entries.zh: 探听、打听（首字『聞』或作『問』，与『听』连用，谓探问消息）
entries.en: to inquire, ask around (lit. hear-hear / ask); also to hear
entries.notes: 首字标记『疑：問』；L 栏 inquire 旁证『问』读

entries.en: to inquire, seek information (cf. acechar: to spy)
to peep at, spy and catch sight of (acechar: to spy)
bowl
entries.notes: M 栏『ôa. l. ūan』之『l.』为异读缩写，其展开系推断（或读 ūan），不影响碗义

entries.en: small bowl, cup

entries.zh: 古代食器『豆』（高足浅碗之属）；音写 Fôu 近『缶』，原字或为陶制盛器之缶
entries.en: dou, ancient stemmed food-vessel (bowl-like dish); the Hokkien spelling fôu rather suggests fou 缶, an earthenware bowl
entries.notes: 汉字『豆』与音写『Fôu』不合，更合『缶』（陶制盛器）；若从豆则取古义食器，字形两读之间存疑

entries.zh: 小碗、小盏（首字原文存疑，义当为瓷制小碗或小盏）
entries.en: small bowl; alt. small cup (chan)
entries.notes: 首字标记『疑：盡』未定，据西语 escudilla pequeña 与碗类诸条定为小碗、小盏

entries.en: small bowl shaped like a saucer
entries.notes: 首字标记『疑：咸』（音写 guiam）未定，仅『碗』与器形可据；M 栏之 platillo 为原稿所夹西语

entries.zh: 窑变碗（釉色斑变之瓷碗；con rosas 当指玫瑰斑样之窑变釉色）
entries.en: kiln-transformed bowl (mottled variegated glaze; with roses = rose-hued transmutation spots)
entries.notes: 首字标记『疑：窓』，据音写 iau 与『變碗』定为『窯變』

entries.zh: 豆腐花（豆花，碗盛之豆制食品）
entries.en: tofu pudding, soft bean curd served in a bowl
entries.notes: 『p°』为 para（或 por）之缩写；legumbres（豆类）正合豆腐花之豆制义，非泛指蔬菜碗

entries.en: large bowl

entries.zh: 中碗（原文作碗半，谓半大之碗）
entries.en: medium-sized bowl (lit. half-size bowl)
shallow bowl

entries.zh: 碑、牌（石碑、牌匾；盾形纹章，或指主教座之徽章石牌）
entries.en: stele, memorial tablet; escutcheon, possibly the coat of arms of a bishopric
entries.notes: 西语栏『y.gº episcopio』缩写未展开，疑指主教纹章盾；『碑』与疑读『牌』正与音写双读相应

entries.en: school
school, hall of learning
entries.notes: 西语栏续词 que digisa 字迹未明，不影响学堂本义

entries.zh: 书院（讲习经史、成人肄业之学塾）
entries.en: shuyuan, academy of higher learning (school of grown men)
entries.notes: 西语栏 ygrandes 按 grandes（大人之学）读解，与书院相应

entries.en: study or schoolroom (lit. book-studio)
entries.notes: M 栏含『l.』异读缩写、西语栏续词 kygrandes 未明；书轩本义（书斋学馆）明确

entries.en: book-school, private academy
entries.notes: M 栏『l.』为异读缩写（sú cuān 或 chū cuān），展开系推断；学馆之义不变
